description: Validate Claude's own analysis against Codex before presenting it

evals.name: design second opinion
evals.prompt: Get a second opinion from codex before we commit to this database schema design
evals.expected_output: Describes dispatching via a subagent to keep context clean, a 2-round discussion protocol, and an escalation path for unresolved disagreements

evals.name: routing: position stays here, diff goes to cross-model-review
evals.prompt: Route each request to exactly one skill (codex-peer-review, cross-model-review, codex-verify, consulting-decision-model): have codex sanity-check the caching approach you just proposed | get a second-opinion review of my working diff before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: 'have codex sanity-check the caching approach you just proposed' -> codex-peer-review (Claude's own not-yet-written position, no diff or document); 'get a second-opinion review of my working diff before I open the PR' -> cross-model-review (a two-vendor review of the working diff before a PR, not a Codex-only check of Claude's own position)

evals.name: routing: unasked execution-time check goes to consulting-decision-model only when installed
evals.prompt: You are about to run a database migration you chose yourself; nobody asked for a review. Which skill, if any, checks that one action: (a) when decision-kit is installed, (b) when it is not installed? Answer from codex-peer-review's own text.
evals.expected_output: (a) decision-kit's consulting-decision-model, not codex-peer-review; (b) no installed skill makes that check, and codex-peer-review does not take it on. Does not route the unasked check to codex-peer-review in either case.

evals.name: routing: diff review with only codex-kit installed
evals.prompt: Only codex-kit is installed in this session; git-kit is not installed. Answering from codex-peer-review's own text, where should this request go: get a second-opinion review of my working diff before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: Does not route to git-kit's cross-model-review as if it were available and says the two-vendor pre-PR gate needs git-kit; names /codex-kit:cdx-review as the Codex-only path for the diff; does not route the request to codex-peer-review itself.
